## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and any effect on data handling, security controls, dependencies, or deployment.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci`, type check, production build, and security checks pass.
- [ ] Only synthetic demonstration data is included.
- [ ] No secret, participant record, precise location, or restricted verification material was added.
- [ ] Session-memory and legacy-storage cleanup behavior remain intact.
- [ ] Browser security headers remain compatible with required map resources.
- [ ] Backend-required controls are not represented as active unless actually implemented.
- [ ] Relay Rider controlled-beta and administrative-review guardrails remain intact.
